name: switchboard
description: Compare exact Uber Eats and DoorDash checkouts using available provider tools or the host browser, including ChatGPT Work cloud browsing on mobile.

interface.longDescription: One request compares the same Uber Eats and DoorDash basket, final totals, applied discounts and delivery windows using available authorized provider tools or the host browser. The skill package does not require desktop MCP configuration or a connected Mac. ChatGPT Work cloud-browser sign-in on mobile depends on plan and rollout; actual mobile availability and provider compatibility still require testing. Uses optional Switchboard comparison tools and cards when separately available; otherwise presents a host-observed table without server validation. Includes an experimental Uber/Lyft workflow. Does not order or book.
interface.defaultPrompt: Compare Uber and Lyft for one standard ride. Ask for my pickup and destination, then check both live prices and times. Do not book.
